DeprecationInformation.depApiMessage: This dataset has been combined with the HMA Subapplications dataset. The Hazard Mitigation Assistance Projects prior version, V4, has been deprecated and is frozen as of August 31, 2026. It will remain until October 15, 2026, at which time it will no longer be available.
